snippet.title: Escape North Korea for the TI-99/4A
snippet.description:
Came also out for:

---


Game description:

A homebrew game that is a mix of action and stealth where the player is a North Korean who wants to get into freedom. Of course, for Kim Jong Un and North Korean military that makes the player a traitor and they will do anything to kill the player.
